meta_description: Batu Kawan 21K 2026: September 13 at Decathlon KLIPPA, Batu Kawan, Penang. A single-distance 21.1K with registration open at Penang's mainland sports hub.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at Decathlon KLIPPA in Batu Kawan — Penang's mainland development zone — this single-distance 21.1K has registration open.
verdict: Batu Kawan 21K is a focused, single-distance half marathon anchored at Decathlon KLIPPA in Batu Kawan — Penang's rapidly developing mainland township. The Decathlon venue provides a sports-themed race hub with all the practical advantages: parking, facilities, and post-race retail therapy. Registration is open. Batu Kawan sits on the Penang mainland, connected to the island by the Second Penang Bridge — making it accessible from both the island and the mainland. A straightforward Penang half marathon for runners wanting a no-fuss, single-distance event.
